name: We Speak Sustainability
tagline: Small actions. Real people. A better world.

verified.label: Verified
verified.text: Checked by our editors against credible independent evidence, usually including an interview.

documented.label: Documented
documented.text: Supported by reliable published sources such as UN agencies, award bodies and reputable journalism. Not yet independently re-verified by our editors.

self-reported.label: Self-reported
self-reported.text: Based mainly on the contributor's own account.

insufficient.label: Insufficient evidence
insufficient.text: Not enough information to publish as a factual claim.
